# pritunl_user_profile (Data Source)

The OpenVPN connection material of a user on a server: the server CA, the user's certificate and key, the tls-auth key and the remotes. It is the content of the profile Pritunl serves for the user, without the lines Pritunl changes on every download, so the values only change when the user, the server or its keys do. Use it to hand a non-interactive client (a CI runner) its connection secrets.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) Organization of the user.
- `server_id` (String) Server the profile connects to; the organization must be attached to it.
- `user_id` (String) User whose profile is read.

### Read-Only

- `ca_cert` (String) PEM certificate of the server CA.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key_direction` (String) The key-direction the profile sets for the tls-auth key.
- `remotes` (List of Object) The remote lines of the profile, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--remotes))
- `tls_auth_key` (String, Sensitive) OpenVPN static key of the server's tls-auth; empty when the server uses none.
- `user_cert` (String) PEM certificate of the user.
- `user_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM private key of the user.

<a id="nestedatt--remotes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `remotes`

Read-Only:

- `host` (String)
- `port` (Number)
- `protocol` (String)
